title: The Vanishing Aurora Diamond
incident: At 8:00 PM, curator Dr. Mira Sen displayed the Aurora Diamond in a locked glass display case at Northbridge Museum. At 8:20 PM, the museum experienced a power failure lasting until 8:24 PM. At 8:30 PM, the diamond was discovered missing. The glass case remained intact with no forced entry. The electronic lock has battery backup and recorded valid authorized-card access at 8:23 PM.
centralQuestions: How was the display case opened during the blackout?
Did the person whose access card was used actually use the card?

timeline.event: Dr. Mira Sen displays the Aurora Diamond in the locked case.
Arjun Vale enters the private archive area.
Guest speaker Theo Park begins keynote address in main auditorium.
Lena Ortiz is seen descending toward the basement power control room.
Main power fails across the museum. Emergency lighting activates partially.
The display case electronic lock records an authorized card swipe registered to Arjun Vale.
Power is restored by the emergency backup generator.
Arjun Vale is recorded leaving the archive carrying a flat catalogue folder.
Dr. Mira Sen discovers the display case empty. The diamond is gone.

suspects.name: Lena Ortiz
suspects.motive: Denied promotion and bonus after a recent contract dispute.
suspects.statement: She states she was in the basement resetting circuit breakers during the blackout.
relevant_evidence: She had access to electrical controls.
Muddy bootprint (E-F) matches her standard-issue boot profile.
supporting_evidence: Basement generator log shows manual reset attempt.
suspicious_evidence: Basement path has unmonitored courtyard connection.
suspects.uncertainty: Matching boot size does not prove she entered the gallery during the theft.
open_questions: When was the muddy footprint deposited?

suspects.name: Theo Park
suspects.motive: Publicity interests and desire for rare gemstone notoriety.
suspects.statement: He says he remained on stage under spotlights for the entire presentation.
relevant_evidence: Continuous CCTV coverage on stage from 8:15 to 8:29 PM.
supporting_evidence: Over 100 audience witnesses saw him continuously on stage.
suspicious_evidence: Expressed private interest in purchasing the diamond earlier.
suspects.uncertainty: Continuous video makes direct physical theft virtually impossible.
open_questions: Could he have coordinated with an accomplice?

suspects.name: Arjun Vale
suspects.statement: He says he was working in the archive and left his keycard inside his jacket in the archive.
relevant_evidence: Keycard registered to him opened case at 8:23 PM.
Blue velvet fibers found in catalogue folder.
supporting_evidence: Camera confirms he entered archive at 8:12 PM and exited at 8:25 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Keycard swipe at 8:23 PM directly contradicts statement that card remained in jacket.
suspects.uncertainty: Keycard access does not prove who physically swiped the card.
open_questions: Could someone have taken the card from his jacket?

suspects.name: Sofia Reed
suspects.motive: Wanted an exclusive investigative scoop on museum security failures.
suspects.statement: She says she was interviewing visitors in the lobby throughout the blackout.
relevant_evidence: Three guests confirm speaking with her during the outage.
supporting_evidence: Audio recorder timestamps corroborate lobby interviews.
suspicious_evidence: Had published critical exposés on museum vulnerabilities.
suspects.uncertainty: Lacks electronic credentials or access to the display case.
open_questions: Did she witness anyone leaving the gallery?

witnesses.name: Dr. Mira Sen
witnesses.statement: The diamond was secure at 8:00 PM and missing at 8:30 PM.
witnesses.limitations: Did not check case between 8:00 and 8:30 PM.

witnesses.name: Marcus Vance
witnesses.statement: All exterior museum doors remained sealed during the outage.
witnesses.limitations: Internal corridor cameras lost feed during blackout.

evidence.title: Electronic Lock Specification
evidence.description: Lock has battery backup and logs authorized-card swipes during outages.
evidence.establishes: Card swipes are recorded accurately during blackout.

evidence.title: Display Case Access Log
evidence.description: Access log shows authorized card #4402 (registered to Arjun Vale) opened case at 8:23 PM.
evidence.establishes: Case opened with Arjun's card at 8:23 PM.

evidence.title: Arjun's Stated Alibi
evidence.description: Arjun stated card remained in his jacket inside the archive.
evidence.establishes: Arjun claims card was unattended in his jacket.
evidence.does_not_establish: Whether card was actually taken or if Arjun is lying.

evidence.title: Archive Exit Footage
evidence.description: CCTV records Arjun exiting archive at 8:25 PM carrying a flat catalogue folder.
evidence.establishes: Arjun exited archive with folder at 8:25 PM.

evidence.title: Blue Velvet Fibers in Folder
evidence.description: Microscopic blue fibers found inside catalogue folder matching display cushion material.
evidence.establishes: Folder was in contact with blue velvet.

evidence.title: Muddy Bootprint
evidence.description: Partial size 7 bootprint found near gallery rear service door.
evidence.establishes: A person wearing size 7 boots walked near service door.
evidence.does_not_establish: Timing of print or unique identity of wearer.

evidence.title: Museum Insurance Policy
evidence.description: High-value insurance policy pays out to museum endowment board upon theft.

redHerrings: The museum insurance policy (E-G) appears to suggest executive fraud, but proceeds only benefit the board.
Lena Ortiz's size 7 bootprint (E-F) appears damning, but she crossed the wet courtyard earlier during normal maintenance.

hiddenSolution.explanation: Pressured by mounting debt, Arjun used his authorized keycard to open the display case at 8:23 PM during the confusion of the blackout, slipped the diamond into his flat catalogue folder, and returned to the archive to stage an alibi.
uncertainties: Exact scientific verification of fiber spectrometry
Whether card could have been stolen from his jacket
hiddenSolution.alternativeExplanation: An inside accomplice stole Arjun's keycard from his unattended jacket in the archive during the blackout.

missingEvidence: Corridor camera footage outside archive doorway
